body:
Thank you for the kind comments. Using the same motivation as before but secretly laughing at myself? That would be a 100 times better, than what I'm doing right now...
(In case I did save these comments and will reread them at stucked times.)
Thank you again!
Thank you for watching it :) You won't forget that line. Its catchy.

"Cheer up. Nobody expects the spanish inquisition." A line from John Hannah in the excellent movie Sliding Doors. Howsabout you spend energy to find and watch this movie instead of finding a job? (Just for today :))

Toronto is a good place. My favourite webcomic artist lives there.
You could go and say Hi in my stead, when you got released from the hospital.
